messages:
Iris (CS): Hey finance, Zenova (ACCT-ZEN-88) says their May invoice INV-2026-05-8821 shows a recurring PROMO-TRIAL that sales intended as one-time. Can someone check?

billing-bot: INV-2026-05-8821 generated 2026-05-06 11:05 UTC. Lines: RESERVED-M 2 GPUs $3,600.00; Usage $45.20; Promo PROMO-TRIAL -100% applied to reserved line; Total due $45.20.

Mark (Billing): Looking. Promo PROMO-TRIAL flagged as "first-bill only" in sales note but our promo engine was mis-tagged as recurring for that promo id. Need proration check because customer downgraded on 2026-05-10.

Iris (CS): Downgrade date 2026-05-10, moved to Reserved-S. Customer provided sales email saying "first month free on Reserved-M". They want a corrected invoice and confirmation that future bills won't get the free month.

Mark (Billing): Proration quick run: Original reserved M $3,600 for 10 days = (10/31)*3600 = 1,161.29; New reserved S for 21 days = (21/31)*2400 = 1,624.52; Prorated reserved = 2,785.81. System applied full month free then prorated -> net under-credit on reserved = 814.19. Also system applied free to usage once incorrectly -> extra credit 20.00. Total net correction owed to customer = -794.19 (i.e., we owe them $794.19). Suggest memo CR-2026-05-211.

Renee (Finance): Approve up to $1,000 for adjustment. Mark, apply credit memo and flag promo config bug with engineering. Also send the customer a short note and updated invoice PDF.

Mark (Billing): Creating credit memo CR-2026-05-211 for $794.19 and applying to INV-2026-05-8821. Added ledger note: "Promo misconfiguration; corrected per sales note. Approver Renee (Finance)."

billing-bot: CreditMemo CR-2026-05-211 created and applied 2026-05-06 15:10 UTC. New balance: $-748.99 (credit carried) pending refund instruction.

Iris (CS): I'll message Zenova to confirm they'd like a refund vs carry-forward. Also attaching CR-2026-05-211 and updated invoice. Closing after customer confirms.
